title: Recipe for Standard BG-11 Media
author: Anna Behle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7kmhku6

steps.title: Prepare 100x BG11 Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 100x BG11 stock solution containing the following concentrations per liter: CaCl2 2H2O (3.6 g L-1), Citric acid (0.6 g L-1), NaNO3 (149.58 g L-1), MgSO4 7H2O (7.49 g L-1), and 0.25 M Na2-EDTA, pH 8.0 (0.56 ml L-1).

substeps.instruction: To prepare 100x BG11 Stock -N, omit the NaNO3.

steps.title: Prepare Individual Component Stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare the following stock solutions at the specified concentrations:

substeps.instruction: 1000x Na2CO3: 20 mg mL-1
100x TES-buffer, pH 8.0 (1M), adjusted with KOH
1000x K2HPO4 x 3H2O: 30 mg mL-1
1000x Fe(III) ammonium citrate: 6 mg mL-1
5000x CuSO4 5H2O: 395 ng mL-1 (sterilize using a filter)

steps.title: Prepare 1000x Trace Metal Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1000x Trace Metal Mix containing the following concentrations per liter: H3BO3 (2.86 g L-1), MnCl2 4H2O (1.81 g L-1), ZnSO4 7H2O (0.222 g L-1), Na2MoO4 2H2O (0.390 g L-1), and Co(NO3)2 6H2O (0.049 g L-1).

substeps.instruction: For media lacking specific metals (e.g., for metal inducible promoters PpetE, PcoaT, PziaA), prepare the mix omitting those specific chemicals.

steps.title: Prepare 1 L BG11 Medium
steps.instruction: Assemble the medium in a 1 L bottle and sterilize.

substeps.instruction: Fill 1 L bottle with 500 mL ultra pure water.
Add 10 mL 100x BG11 Stock, 1 mL 1000x Na2CO3, 1 mL 1000x K2HPO4 x 3H2O, 10 mL 100x TES-buffer, and 1 mL 1000x Trace Metal Mix.
Add ultra pure water to reach a final volume of 1 L.
Autoclave the solution.
After autoclaving, add 1 mL 1000x Fe(III) ammonium citrate.
Optional: After autoclaving, add 200 µL 5000x CuSO4.

steps.title: Prepare BG11 Stock -N Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare nitrogen-free BG11 medium in either 1 L or 500 mL volumes.

substeps.instruction: For 1 L: Fill 1 L bottle with 500 mL ultra pure water; add 10 mL 100x BG11 Stock -N, 1 mL 1000x Na2CO3, 1 mL 1000x K2HPO4 x 3H2O, 10 mL 100x TES-buffer, and 1 mL 1000x Trace Metal Mix; top up to 1 L with ultra pure water.

For 500 mL: Fill 500 mL bottle with 250 mL ultra pure water; add 10 mL 100x BG11 Stock -N, 1 mL 1000x Na2CO3, 1 mL 1000x K2HPO4 x 3H2O, 10 mL 100x TES-buffer (pH 8.0), and 1 mL 1000x Trace Metal Mix; top up to 500 mL with ultra pure water.
Autoclave the solution.
After autoclaving, add 1 mL sterile 1000x Fe(III) ammonium citrate.
Optional: After autoclaving, add 200 µL sterile 5000x CuSO4.

steps.title: Prepare 1.5% Agar
steps.instruction: Prepare the agar base for plating.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 4.5 g Bacto Agar.
Fill up to 300 mL with water.
Autoclave.
Microwave agar until liquid.
Allow to cool.

steps.title: Cast BG11 Agar Plates
steps.instruction: Combine medium and agar to pour plates.

substeps.instruction: In a 50 mL Falcon tube, add 1 volume of 2x BG11 and 1 volume of liquid 1.5% agar (typically 30-40 mL total per plate).
When the mixture is hand warm, add appropriate antibiotics if required.
Quickly pour onto plates, avoiding air bubbles.
